Jon P.: quick check-in re: Willow small-preview onboarding. NDA confirmed yesterday, they want telemetry + a short bench run.
Rhea K.: great. metric ask was p50/p95/p99 latency, per-gpu power, and kv-cache hit-rate. they prefer protobuf uploads to s3.
Anil S.: note: include per-process RSS and GPU temp samples every 30s. agent flag: --format=proto --interval=30 --kv-capture=on
Infra Ops: added cross-account role for s3://willow-eap and created KMS key alias/willow-eap. policy attached.
Willow Legal Bot: NDA WIL-2026-58 stored in vault by @sarah. Sharing: aggregated metrics + sanitized traces only. Raw logs stay in Redwood.
Rhea K.: onboarding checklist (draft): 1) verify NDA in vault, 2) provision bucket + IAM role, 3) deploy agent, 4) handshake test, 5) 10-min bench runs with tags will-peer-1, will-peer-2, 6) collect artifacts.
Jon P.: bench config: 8-token warmup, seq=1024, batch sizes [1,4], 10-minute run. tag runs will-eap-initial.
Anil S.: will add tiny repro to trigger p99 spike and a short script to reproduce. saving under /partnerships/willow/repros.
Rhea K.: marketing note: no public listing until GA + legal signoff. set marketplace_embargo=true on the partner record.
Infra Ops: can provide a short aggregated live stream (1s windows) for Willow debugging. tokens expire at session end.
Jon P.: owners: Rhea - partner PM & comms, Anil - bench + repro, Infra Ops - infra + IAM, Jon - overall sync. reconvene after bench. :rocket:
